versions.changelog:
Skill version 1.0.0 – Initial release focused on marketing attribution.

- Helps users choose, interpret, and reconcile attribution models to understand which marketing efforts drive conversions and revenue.
- Covers both attribution model interpretation (first-touch vs last-touch, multi-touch, model selection, and number reconciliation) and guidance on building first-party attribution when needed.
- Clarifies boundaries with neighboring skills (analytics, ads, revops, ai-seo) to reduce confusion.
- Includes practical advice, model summaries, common pitfalls, and rules of thumb for attribution analysis.
- Guides users based on business context and helps set realistic expectations regarding attribution accuracy.
